facts.text: Lizzie soon awoke and her sleepy little face looked precious.
Lizzie’s morning voice was cute.
Lizzie called Alyssa to her meditation chamber about an hour after lunch.
When Alyssa entered the meditation chamber, Lizzie was only wearing her undergarments again, as usual.
Lizzie had the Grand Admiral badge pinned to her bra in the meditation chamber.
Lizzie had her uniform folded neatly next to her chair in the meditation chamber.
Lizzie’s artwork holograms in the meditation chamber were different, with a vast majority being holos of sculptures.
Lizzie shyly asked Alyssa if Alyssa would be interested in being Lizzie’s girlfriend.
Lizzie, Alyssa, and Mila traveled to the Industrious planet of Bastion.
Bastion was described as the temporary capital of the Empire.
The old capital of Coruscant was still under the control of the New Republic.
Lizzie and Alyssa took a shuttle down to Bastion.
Lizzie and Alyssa went to the Imperial Capital building on Bastion.
Lizzie was the current ruler of the empire.
Alyssa was following alongside Lizzie.
Mila was standing intimidatingly with Lizzie and Alyssa.
Mila was clad in combat gear and armed to the tits.
Lizzie planned to bring up Zsinj, a former warlord for the empire.
Zsinj broke away from the empire and formed his own warlord kingdom.
Zsinj was attempting to rebuild the empire his own way.
Zsinj’s empire had the old Sith Worlds at its core.
The old Sith Worlds were not a recent acquisition for Zsinj.
Zsinj had the old Sith Worlds almost since the start of his splinter empire.
Zsinj’s splinter empire was headed on the non-Sith planet of Serenno.
Lizzie wanted the Sith Worlds.
Zsinj was causing issues for both the Empire and the Republic.
Lizzie believed the two sides might temporarily cease hostilities to partition Zsinj’s empire.
Mila is a pantherkin.
In the formerly-Imperial Palace on Coruscant, Mon Mothma received word from a secretary.
Mon Mothma was the current Chancellor of the Republic's Provisional Council.
The current leader of the Remnants of the Galactic Empire wanted to speak with Mon Mothma.
The leader’s name was Lizzie Ó Muirgheasa.
Lizzie Ó Muirgheasa refused to meet anywhere in person.
Lizzie Ó Muirgheasa chose to speak over holoprojector.
